title: Publish your own run

scenes.heading: The test ran behind a firewall
scenes.sub: Keep the run details before leaving.
voice: Your team ran a cluster check, and a reviewer wants to see exactly what it tested.
Have AICR emit evidence with the recipe, cluster snapshot, and results.

scenes.heading: Move the evidence to a signing host
scenes.sub: Validation and signing can run separately.
voice: When the cluster network cannot reach the signing service, take the emitted evidence to a host that can.
Sign and publish the bundle there, to an OCI registry.

scenes.heading: Send a pointer to reviewers
scenes.sub: The digest selects the specific bundle.
voice: Share the generated pointer with your reviewer.
Its digest selects the exact bundle, so the signature can be checked against the content and the signing identity.

scenes.heading: Verify the evidence
voice: A reviewer can run AICR evidence verify with the published pointer.
For upstream contributions, follow the project's keyless signing and source registration process so the results can be reviewed in context.

payoff: Move validation evidence from a cluster network to a signer and give reviewers an independently verifiable pointer.
